title: Greenhouse Gas Auditor: Georgia and Israel deep edition

questions.q: In "Read your local market Understand", which of these is a key idea?
o: Partner with a local college, chamber or training body to find helpers and to practise.
Check against a worse case: if sales are 25% lower, do you still cover costs?
Language: one page in the local language, one in English; never mix currencies on one price.
Start with one customer type and one boundary, such as direct fuel and power use for a small firm.

questions.q: In "Choose your sector Analyse", which of these is a key idea?
o: Compare the types by tax, liability and filing work before you choose; write the table. Check with a local expert.
Compare three models: one-off audit, a yearly programme, training and tools. Pick by repeat income.
Launch with a go or no-go rule: 3 paid audits in 8 weeks, each with a source-linked report and one renewal. Check with a local expert.
Two different countries, two sets of rules. Pick the country first, then use that country’s list in every module. Check with a local expert.

questions.q: In "Register and license Apply", which of these is a key idea?

Employment rules, notice and social contributions differ; read the one for the country of the worker. Check with a local expert.
